title: Listen and Choose a Response — Coursework

questions.stem: When are Professor Kim's office hours this week?

options.A: Her office is in Hall B.
options.B: They're on the syllabus, but I think Tuesday afternoon.
options.C: Yes, she was in her office.
options.D: I worked for about two hours.

questions.explanation: This gives a likely time and where to confirm it. The others answer where, use Yes, or repeat 'hours'.
